# catalyst_auth_user (Data Source)

Read an existing application's user access metadata. Requires ZohoCatalyst.projects.users.READ. Does not store the user's email, name, organization, locale or profile in Terraform state. This is user-role discovery, not authentication setup, role provisioning or permission management.

## Example Usage

```terraform
variable "project_id" { type = string }
variable "user_id" { type = string }

data "catalyst_auth_user" "example" {
  project_id = var.project_id
  user_id    = var.user_id
}

output "role_id" {
  value = data.catalyst_auth_user.example.role_id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `project_id` (String) Existing Catalyst project's positive numeric ID as a string.
- `user_id` (String) Existing application user's positive numeric ID as a string.

### Read-Only

- `role_id` (String) Assigned role ID as a precision-preserving string.
- `role_name` (String) Assigned role's current name.
- `status` (String) Account status reported by Catalyst; not managed.
- `user_type` (String) Account type reported by Catalyst.
